name: Relay
purpose: Local-first assistant interface and controlled bridge to Homebase capabilities.
rules: Use HomebaseAgent instead of duplicating fetch wrappers.
Local agent tools return metadata, not ROM bytes, saves, credentials, or arbitrary shell access.
Every state-changing action stays visible and requires an explicit user interaction.
Generated apps remain inside user-apps and do not gain core-file write access.
Core edits use the workspace allowlist, explicit typed confirmation, and a timestamped local backup.
